audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD / diffRating 8/10 contradicts a 52.15% Xerath win rate over 2673 games and a levelChart that reads Xerath on all seven rows.
audit.why: Xerath out-ranges LeBlanc's 700-range Q and 925-range Ethereal Chains with a charged Q, and his E (13s at rank 1) answers her only gap-closer, Distortion (15s at rank 1). She is a threat, not a losing lane.
audit.corrected: diff TRICKY, diffRating 6/10, carryRating 8/10, difficulty line restated to match.

audit.why: Spike ladder (Lost Chapter 4-5, Rite of the Arcane at 6, Luden's) is accurate and matches the phase labels; Mimic at 45/35/25 adds a second Distortion or a second chain to her burst spike, which the cooldowns field now records.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Distortion 15s->10s, Shocking Orb 13s and Mimic 45s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were stated vaguely and without numbers: Distortion's 4s return window, Ethereal Chains' 1.5s shackle-to-root delay, and Mirror Image firing at 40% health were absent or generic.
audit.why: Ethereal Chains only roots if the shackle holds 1.5 seconds, so breaking line of sight or the distance leash inside that window denies her entire setup; Distortion's return leaves her with no escape once used aggressively; Mirror Image triggers below 40% health, so the clone and 1s invisibility arrive exactly when your R would finish her.
audit.corrected: enemyWin, tradeBad, dosFull, dontsFull and breakdown.cooldowns now name the abilities and the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that exists to hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Distortion 15s rank 1 / 10s rank 5, Shocking Orb 13s, Mimic 45s.

notes: Full-layer phases[N].side read "LeBlanc" on all seven rows while content win[N] read "Xerath" on all seven — a two-layer disagreement on every row of this chart. The whys in both layers describe Xerath winning, the packet levelChart is all Xerath, and the win rate is 52.15% over 2673 games, so the full layer was the wrong one; side edits proposed alone (win[N] already correct, no no-ops). tone left at #ff5d6c (the HARD colour) even though diff moves to TRICKY — I do not have the diff-to-tone colour mapping in the brief and will not guess a hex. Xerath's E is called "Shocking Orb" in the existing page text; the brief's ownerKit does not carry ability names, so I reused the page's own name rather than inventing one. Ratings on phases[N] left untouched: with side corrected to Xerath they read as strength-of-advantage and are plausible as they stand.
